VenueCalendar.description:
One venue's trading week, holidays, and half-days over the window.

Together the first three fields describe the window exactly: a date in it
is a session iff it appears in ``extraSessions``, or its weekday is in
``tradingDays`` and it is not in ``closures``.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the venue's local clock
timezone.title: Timezone

tradingDays.description: Weekdays the venue currently trades, ISO numbering (1 = Monday .. 7 = Sunday). Read from the venue's recent sessions, so do not assume Mon-Fri: some venues trade a different week, and a venue can change its week mid-window (see extraSessions)
tradingDays.title: Tradingdays

closures.description: Dates in the window that fall on a tradingDays weekday but had no session
closures.title: Closures

extraSessions.description: Sessions in the window on a weekday outside tradingDays — normally empty, non-empty when the venue changed its trading week during the window
extraSessions.title: Extrasessions

halfDays.description: Sessions in the window that close early
halfDays.title: Halfdays

symbols.description: symbol -> exchange_calendars name, null when the ticker maps to no modelled venue. Always the full tracked book, even when the venues map is filtered, since this is the only place the mapping is published. A name here may be absent from venues (filtered out, or its calendar failed to build) — fall back to the calendar-less approximation for those symbols
